name: Circles Open Spring 2017

venue.name: Gender Equality Center Yokohama
venue.details: The hall on the first floor.

information: Circles Open Winter 2017 is organized by a cubing circles union of the University of Tokyo and Keio University. It can be considered as the 7th UT Open and includes the unofficial event "Inter-Circles Cube Relay" (formerly "Inter-University Cube Relay.")
